L6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
A negative on L2 is about THESE coordinates -- 1,336 genes' log2 levels -- not about
the framework. The state the theory names includes protein, PTM, metabolite,
localisation and mechanics, none of which this series measures. Failing to find an
autonomous field in a projection is EXPECTED if the projection omits the variables
that make it autonomous, and that is the most likely reading of a FAIL.
L4's Jacobian is LINEAR. A curl-free nonlinear flow can look rotational under a
linear fit, so the antisymmetric part bounds how well a linear potential describes
the flow, not how well any potential does.
L3 cannot separate theta adapting from the environment changing: dexamethasone's
effect is itself time-varying, so a non-stationary F is consistent with a static
controller driven by a changing input.
